# String <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
String:String string:String, repeat:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text to repeat. |
| `repeat` | In | Int32 | required | How many copies to join. 0 gives an empty string. |

**Returns:** The repeated text.

## Description

Repeats a string several times.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print String$("ab", 3)
```

```text
ababab
```
